            best_gain = 0.0
            best_i = best_j = None
            for i in range(n - 1):

                        best_i, best_j = i, j

        seg0 = tour[:cuts[0]]
        seg1 = tour[cuts[0]:cuts[1]]
        seg2 = tour[cuts[1]:cuts[2]]
